title: Admin Scheduler
description:
Job Title: Admin Scheduler
Location: Newtownabbey
Hours: Full Time Hours, Monday - Friday, 8am-4pm, 37 hours each week
Salary: £13.69 per hour
Duration: Temporary

Application Deadline: 5pm 3rd September

Essential Criteria:
- IT proficiency: Intermediate.
- 1-5 years' relevant administrative experience.
- Hold a BTEC National Certificate (Level 3) plus at least 1 year relevant administrative experience; OR five GCSEs (Level 2) plus at least 2 years' relevant administrative experience; OR demonstrate 3 years' general administrative experience with evidence of ongoing learning/training.
- Basic AccessNI check (required) once candidate offered and accepted the position

About the Role
On behalf of our client, Apple Recruitment Services are seeking an Admin Scheduler. The post will accurately diagnose and record maintenance repairs for Housing Executive tenants, triage customer calls to create work orders, schedule and reschedule appointments, and track repairs progress to meet contract KPIs.

Key Responsibilities:

MAIN DUTIES
The successful candidate will be required to:
Work within a small team to deliver a range of services which will include, but is not limited to, the following:
- Contact tenants by telephone and arrange appointments.
- Schedule or reschedule all appointments to suit tenants and or business needs
- Process sub-contractor completions and input real time events for job completion.
- Correlate out of hour's task data and track task progress, and process accordingly to meet deadlines.
- Communicate effectively with Tenants, NIHE staff and other statutory bodies.
- Deal with tenants queries, effectively and efficiently.
- Save and retain a variety of documents for audit purposes.
- Use of both the DLO IT systems and HMS (Housing Management System).
- Have a comprehensive knowledge of the schedule of rates
- Carry out inspections for missing data, certificates and other system compliance issues.
- Work as part of a team and communicate to a high level and in a professional manner both internally and externally.
- May be required to provide cover on a rota basis to 20.00 Mon to Fri and to 2.00 on a Saturday.
- Any other duties as required.

How To Apply

If you wish to apply or would like more information, please email your CV using the link to Darcie. Applicants must ensure their CV is accurate and up to date, including full employment history, academic achievements and contact details. Only applicants meeting the essential criteria will be considered.

Apple Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. Apple Recruitment Services is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Medical Receptionist (21.5 hrs pw)
description:
My Client based BT13 area of Belfast require a Medical Receptionist to join their team on a part-time basis. Reporting to the Practice Manager you will provide a point of contact for patients; to assist in the day to day running of the surgery; to act as a point of communication between patients, doctors and other medical staff. This post is temporary with the view to becoming permanent

Reception Duties:
- General reception duties - greeting patients in person and on telephone
- Making, cancelling appointments
- Providing information regarding practice services
- Entries into patient's computer records as directed
- Liaising with pharmacist, nursing homes, where required to provide repeat prescriptions when authorised
- Coordinating patient appointments, hospital letters, prescription requests and information with the Treatment Room nurses and other staff members to ensure procedures are effective, and patient's and Doctor's requirements are met in an efficient and accurate manner
- Diary management
- Maintain a tidy reception desk and public areas
- Organising, filing and maintaining patient records
- Undertake opening and locking -up of surgery as required

Essential Criteria:
- Previous experience in a similar role to include telephone & face to face contact (Previous proven experience in a GP surgery advantageous)
- Fully computer literate
- Excellent communication & organisational skills
- Educated to GCSE grades A - C including English & Maths
- Flexible approach to work.
- An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality.
- An ability to use own judgement, resourcefulness, personal initiative and knowledge to
- respond to patients' enquiries and requests

21.5 hours pw - Mon 8.30am - 6pm, Wed 8.30am - 1pm & Fri 8.30am - 6pm

£12.98 per hour

title: Recruitment Administrator (12 month contract)
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Recruitment Administrator to join our HR Services team, based in the A&O Shearman Belfast office.
Early Careers team - Belfast
This Recruitment Administrator position sits within our Early Careers (EC) Recruitment team, which focuses on graduate and apprenticeship recruitment across various global offices. Working within a team of 11 in our Belfast office, you will have extensive contact with candidates, external recruitment partners, universities and colleagues in our London office. Given the nature of Early Careers recruitment, elements of the role will be cyclical, providing variety over the course of the recruitment year. Additionally, you will get the chance to work on ad-hoc projects to further enhance our offering to students and graduates.
What you will do The Recruitment Administrator will help facilitate delivery of the firm's EC recruitment strategy, and support the candidate-facing work of the UK Early Careers Recruitment team. You will work closely with the Early Careers Operations Manager and other members of the wider Early Careers Recruitment team.
- Operational Support - provide administrative and operational support to the EC Operations Manager and wider EC Recruitment team
- Programme Management - support a range of EC programmes, building relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensure that candidates are sourced, screened and offered in accordance with agreed procedures
- Screening - support application screening throughout the EC recruitment cycle, especially during the busiest seasons of Vacation Scheme and Training Contract recruitment
- Interview Management - source interviewers, schedule interviews and organise assessment days, gather feedback from interviewers and pass this on to candidates
- University Engagement - liaise with university careers offices, student bodies and brand ambassadors to promote awareness of A&O Shearman brand on campus
- Events - support with organising a wide range of events, including vacation schemes & other EC programmes and university & schools' outreach
- Projects - assist as required with a variety of EC Recruitment projects and initiatives
- Expenses - collate and process expenses from event, interview and programme attendees
- Reporting - prepare regular and bespoke reports as required
- Shared mailbox - manage and respond to a queries received into the EC Recruitment mailbox
- Governance - adhere to established EC governance in terms of creating and storing programme and process documentation
- Travel - very occasional travel to London office to support with programme delivery (usually 1-2 times per year)

What you will have
- Administrative experience in a corporate environment (desirable)
- Strong interest in developing your career in a HR / Recruitment environment
- Strong team ethic and able to work well with others
- Excellent attention to detail
- Very good organisational skills - able to structure and prioritise workload to ensure that competing deliverables are met within required timeframes
- Positive, pro-active attitude - eager to find, suggest and implement programme and process improvements
- Ability to work well under pressure and deliver during busiest times
- Strong communicator - written and verbal
- Ability to establish and maintain credibility with key stakeholders and specialist teams.
- Competent in Microsoft Office packages.
- Able to travel to London office 1-2 times per year to support with programme delivery

What we can offer you
